about: Skill bundles with the verdict every pre-send check must reach: tools/tests (check_bundle.py) and, later, the publish helper's hooks. A case builds its folder from `files` (UTF-8 text), `binary` (hex), `links` (symbolic links) and `generate` (filler files, or one filler file sized so the folder totals `pad_to_bytes`). `at` lists [path, line, column] the check must report, 1-based. `{{fake_aws_key}}` in a file stands for "AKIA" followed by "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP", substituted when the folder is built so no credential-shaped string is committed. A case with `applies_to: ["hook"]` tests the files_from expansion, not a folder.
